scorer.authority: The scorer derives selection, payload reads, reset/invalidation counts, evaluated ranges, and execution mode from a consecutive ordered primitive-event stream. No caller-supplied verdict, mode, eligibility, selected payload, reset count, or evaluated range exists in the schema.

regimes.confirmation: After candidate freeze, two distinct fixtures and their selection hashes are derived from one fresh public-randomness digest. Both must satisfy the complete primary, guard, state, numerical, and containment contract.

checkpoint_inventory.selection_formula: Choose the unique longest structurally valid record whose rendered prefix, canonical token prefix, and complete lineage match and whose length does not exceed the independently observed common-token frontier.

operation_receipts.binding: Every event has a consecutive sequence number and invocation ID. Candidate observations bind record identity, checkpoint length, payload hash, completed bytes, and exact evaluator start/end positions to the inventory.
operation_receipts.false_pass_rejection: Any reset, invalidation, evaluation before the selected checkpoint, wrong payload read, reordered primitive, or full cold evaluation in a candidate invocation rejects even if logits and output happen to match.

guard_matrix.legacy_bypass: DS4_GLM_RESUME_GUARD_OFF is absent in every launch. Only DS4_GLM_LIVE_REWIND_V1=1 may enable the eligible GLM extension case; all other values retain strict behavior.

lineage_and_state.tokens: Canonical complete I32 token vectors, full UTF-8 wire bytes, and the tokenizer-produced monotonic token-to-wire byte boundary map are scorer-decoded. Inventory prefix lengths and hashes are recomputed from that map. Cold, strict, candidate, synchronized, restored-prefix, and final lineage hashes are recomputed from token vectors; every token ID must be in the GLM vocabulary.
lineage_and_state.coverage: The complete canonical session payload is partitioned contiguously into a header and exactly 75 layer sections. Each section has its own byte count and content hash; the manifest root, total bytes, token lineage, and all 75 logical frontiers are checked.
lineage_and_state.equality: Cold, strict, and candidate complete manifests must be exactly equal. Removing a section or changing any unprobed row rejects.

numerical_acceptance.malformed_policy: Non-finite data, non-finite derived metrics, malformed base64, trailing streams, and decompression beyond the exact bounded size reject.
